voicehook.description: Talk with your agents. Remote MCP server for voicehook.ai voice calls in the browser. Your agent can start a call and hand you the link (create_call), or join a call you opened (join). It talks with say, listens with next and keeps a status board up to date (status, activity, show) while it keeps working. No key to paste. About 10 free minutes every day, no login needed.
